recognize_zh: 周邊血中兩顆小至中型淋巴樣細胞，胞質稀少、核輪廓不規則，其中一顆核有明顯凹陷/切跡（notched），染色質成熟、無明顯核仁；雖不是典型的深裂「臀型」細胞，仍提示濾泡性淋巴瘤周邊血浸潤，須以流式細胞儀（CD10+）確認。
features: Two small to intermediate lymphoid cells, slightly larger than red cells
Scant rim of pale basophilic cytoplasm (high N:C ratio)
Irregular nuclear contours with indentation/notching; classic deep clefts not prominent
Condensed mature chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two small to intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm and irregular, indented nuclear contours with mature condensed chromatin and no conspicuous nucleoli. The deep, cleaved 'buttock' nuclei classically described in follicular lymphoma are not prominent in these cells, which are also somewhat larger than typical. Background red cells are unremarkable. In a patient with known follicular lymphoma, the findings are consistent with circulating lymphoma cells with atypical morphology; flow cytometry demonstrating a light chain-restricted CD10+ B-cell population is required, as morphology alone cannot distinguish other small B-cell lymphomas.

ddx.vs: CLL cells are small and round with 'soccer ball' chromatin and smudge cells, and are CD5+/CD23+/CD10- on flow cytometry.
MCL cells also show notched nuclei but are CD5+/CD10-/cyclin D1+ with t(11;14).
SMZL cells often have polar villous cytoplasmic projections and are CD5-/CD10- B cells.
Reactive lymphocytes are polymorphous with more abundant cytoplasm and show polyclonal light chain expression.
